definitions.explanation: The reduction of energy use through efficient equipment and habits; the full form of the common abbreviation {省|しょう}エネ.

examples.japanese: {省|しょう}エネルギーに{取|と}り{組|く}む。
examples.english: We are working on energy conservation.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{家電|かでん}は{省|しょう}エネルギー{性能|せいのう}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: New home appliances have high energy efficiency.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{企業|きぎょう}に{省|しょう}エネルギーの{努力|どりょく}を{求|もと}めている。
examples.english: The government is calling on companies to make energy-conservation efforts.

notes:
The full form of {省|しょう}エネ. Composed of {省|しょう} (to economize on) + エネルギー (energy, from English).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {省|しょう}エネルギー{対策|たいさく}: energy-conservation measures
- {省|しょう}エネルギー{機器|きき}: energy-saving equipment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {省|しょう}エネ: the everyday shortened form, far more common in speech
- {節電|せつでん}: saving electricity specifically — narrower than energy in general
